q: A numerical ledger is essentially which type of account?
Numerical ledgers are maintained by which office?
Each distinct item of stores in a numerical ledger is given what?
A numerical ledger folio normally shows which columns?

options.D: Date, voucher number, receipts, issues and balance

q: Postings to the numerical ledger are made from which source?
The balance in a numerical ledger folio represents what?

options.D: The quantity of the item in stock

q: How do bin cards differ from numerical ledgers?

options.A: Bin cards record values; ledgers record quantities
options.B: Bin cards are kept by Accounts
options.D: Bin cards are kept at depots by Stores staff; ledgers are kept by Accounts

q: Numerical ledgers are generally arranged according to what?
Verification of numerical ledger balances is done by comparing them with what?
Who carries out the physical verification of stores?
During verification, the quantities counted are recorded on what?
Differences between ledger balances and physical stock are adjusted through which account?
A negative balance in a numerical ledger folio usually indicates what?

options.A: An error, such as an issue posted without the receipt

q: Corrections in a numerical ledger should be made how?

options.B: By a fresh correcting entry, not by overwriting

q: Receipts returned by works to the depot are posted in the numerical ledger as what?
Transfers of stores between depots are posted in the sending depot's ledger as what?
New folios in the numerical ledger are opened when what happens?

options.A: A new item of stores comes into stock

q: Folios of items no longer stocked are dealt with how?
The unit of quantity in a numerical ledger folio is determined by what?

options.A: The standard unit prescribed for the item

q: Monthly totals of receipts and issues in the numerical ledger are used for what?
The numerical ledger must agree periodically with which other record?
Who is responsible for reconciling bin cards with numerical ledgers?

options.C: The Stores and Accounts staff jointly

q: Postings in the numerical ledger should be made with what frequency?
An index to the numerical ledger helps to do what?

options.C: Locate the folio of any item quickly

q: Verification of numerical ledger postings is an example of what?
Stock verification is normally conducted on what basis?

options.A: A periodical programme covering all depots

q: Surprise verification of stores is intended to achieve what?
When physical stock exceeds the ledger balance, the difference is treated as what?

options.A: A loss to be written off
options.B: A surplus to be taken on charge

q: When physical stock is less than the ledger balance, the difference is treated as what?

options.A: A deficiency needing enquiry and sanction

q: The priced ledger is reconciled with the numerical ledger to ensure what?
Which voucher supports an issue entry in the numerical ledger?
Which voucher supports a receipt entry in the numerical ledger?
Numerical ledgers of a depot show the stock position as on what date?

options.A: Up to the date of the last posting

q: Opening balances in numerical ledger folios at the start of the year are what?

options.B: The closing balances of the previous year

q: Control totals of the numerical ledger are useful for what?
Errors discovered after monthly closing are corrected in which month?

options.A: By altering last month's closed books
options.B: The current month by fresh entries

q: The numerical ledger is a permanent record and must be preserved for what purpose?
Custody of numerical ledgers rests with whom?
Fractions of the unit in quantity balances are shown how?

options.A: As prescribed for the item, without unnecessary decimals

q: Issue of stores without a proper voucher results in what?
Stock sheets prepared during verification are signed by whom?

options.B: The stock verifier and the depot holder

q: Discrepancies that cannot be explained after enquiry are reported to whom?
The numerical ledger folio heading includes which details?

options.A: Nomenclature, class and unit of the item

q: Posting of the same voucher twice in the numerical ledger causes what?

options.D: An inflated balance or double issue

q: A stores suspense head in accounts is used for what?
Year-end balances of numerical ledgers are certified by whom?

options.C: The Accounts officer in charge of Stores Accounts

q: Stores received but not yet inspected are shown in the numerical ledger as what?
Materials issued on loan to contractors are accounted as what?
The main safeguard provided by numerical ledgers is what?

options.C: An independent quantity check on depot stocks

q: Which statement about numerical ledgers is correct?

options.D: They record quantities and must agree with physical stock
